case: Case 7 · The Dog That Stayed Quiet
title: Agnes's Notebook
_how: Same format as case-01.json. Every item gets the same pop-in and highlight; nothing is marked differently before 'The Solution.'

items.text: Sir Reginald: red hat, white beard, fishing rod — finest gnome in the Cove
Tuesday morning: Sir Reginald was gone
High thick hedge; only way in is the little wooden gate
Pickle sleeps in the porch facing the gate and barks at everyone
Pickle never barks at Loveday or her grandson Pip
Mr Hocking awake until two — night still, Pickle did not bark once

items.name: Mrs Ashby
items.text: holidaymaker; would give anything for a gnome like him

items.name: Mr Fenwick
items.text: grocer; his own gnome has lost to Sir Reginald three years running

items.name: Pip Carew
items.text: Loveday's grandson; was round yesterday — "but he's a good boy"

solution.text: Only Loveday and Pip never set Pickle off. Loveday was in bed — so it was Pip.
